title: Simplified Implementation of the Microsoft SDL — enumerations and the compliance-tracking record (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED by this library from the paper's prose; Microsoft publishes no schema. Enum values are verbatim names from the cited sections.

PrivacyImpactRating.description: P1 High Privacy Risk; P2 Moderate Privacy Risk; P3 Low Privacy Risk

Role.x-source: Roles, Responsibilities, and Qualifications of Security Personnel

MandatoryPractice.description: SDL Practice number; 'the development team must successfully complete sixteen mandatory security activities'

ComplianceRecord.description: An entry in the 'specially designated application ... to track compliance with the SDL' (Application Security Verification Process). Field list INFERRED from the artifacts the section names.

artifacts.x-source: 'including (but not limited to) design and implementation notes, threat models, tool log uploads, and other process attestations'
